title: BMA executor bma-file types
description: fs.mount and fs.unmount (machine-scoped executors with the fs capability). bma-file HTTP routes live on the executor host at <service_url>/machines/{machine_id}/fs/<op> (service_url ends in /v1, for example https://executor.example.com/v1; machine_id is the executor's BMA_MACHINE_ID; the previous <origin>/v1/fs/<op> stays as an alias); they are authenticated with the mount token, not executor methods.

FsMount.description: One view to mount. path is the absolute mount point on the executor host (derived from session_files by the harness). readonly is also fixed inside token; the executor mounts read-only when it is true. token is a capability token for this session and machine: keep it in memory only, never write it to disk, argv, environment or logs.

view.description: uploads (FS1). Open enum: outputs, skills and memory follow.

options.description: Reserved mount tuning (string values); unknown keys are ignored.

FsMountResult.description: fs.mount result. state is "mounted" once every listed view is mounted and serving, or "failed" with error_code and error (nothing stays half-mounted).

FsUnmountResult.description: fs.unmount result. pending_bytes is data not yet committed to bma-file when flush was requested (always 0 for read-only views).
